basic_identification.full_title: Specification for Iron Powder (Reduction Grade) (लोहे के बुरादे (अपचायक ग्रेड) की विशिष्टि) (First Revision)
basic_identification.sector_category: Chemical / Inorganic Chemicals (approved by the Chemical Division Council and finalized by the Inorganic Chemicals (Miscellaneous) Sectional Committee, CDC 3, of the Bureau of Indian Standards)

scope.summary: This standard specifies the physical form, chemical composition, quality tolerances, testing methods, and field sampling plans for iron powder (reduction grade) used primarily as a chemical reducing agent in chemical synthesis and industrial metallurgy.

version_status_and_amendments.amendment_slips: No active amendments have been issued on this reaffirmed copy (NIL on this copy).

cross_referenced_standards_top_20.title: Rules for rounding off numerical values (revised)
cross_referenced_standards_top_20.relevance: Standardises the mathematical rounding of evaluated parameters and testing values to determine code compliance.

cross_referenced_standards_top_20.title: Specification for hydrochloric acid (revised)
cross_referenced_standards_top_20.relevance: Specifies purity requirements for concentrated hydrochloric acid used to dissolve iron samples for analytical testing.

allied_standards.title: Volumetric and spectrophotometric estimation of iron
allied_standards.relevance: Provides standard volumetric and colorimetric/spectrophotometric assays to calibrate total iron content in chemical products.

allied_standards.title: Ready Mixed Paint, Stoving, Red Oxide Zinc Chrome, Priming — Specification
allied_standards.relevance: Regulates iron-oxide-pigmented stoving primers, where total iron concentration is audited using standard volumetric analysis.

allied_standards.title: Code of Practice on Occupational Safety and Health Audit
allied_standards.relevance: Regulates safety audits in chemical plants, auditing air-monitoring and protective equipment (PPE) required when handling highly active, flammable reduction iron powders and toxic reagents like bromine.

allied_standards.title: Drinking Water — Specification
allied_standards.relevance: Restricts dissolved iron concentration in municipal water supplies to prevent pipe deposits and taste degradation.

allied_standards.title: Code of Practice for General Steel Construction
allied_standards.relevance: The master structural steel code in India, regulating support framing, walkway railings, ladders, and protective enclosures for chemical warehouses, reactors, and powder blending yards.

certification_and_marking.certification_status: Voluntary Product Specification. Manufacturers are highly encouraged to apply for a BIS license to print the prestigious 'Standard Mark' (ISI Mark) on HDPE bags or steel drums as a certified guarantee of material purity and high reduction activity. Additionally, compliance with IS 1612 is heavily integrated into commercial purchase contracts for dyestuffs, pharmaceutical intermediates, and chemical reagents across India.

requirements.detail: Under this first revision, the maximum limit of carbon impurity is strictly lowered from 2.5 to 2.0 percent by mass to prevent filtration difficulties when isolating organic products.
A mandatory chemical reduction activity test is incorporated because iron powders with identical chemical purity and particle size can show significant differences in reduction efficiency.
The total elemental iron (Fe) content must satisfy a minimum specified percentage (nominally 93.0 percent by mass, with a tolerance of ±2.0 percent) to ensure adequate reducing equivalent.
Moisture and volatile components are restricted to a maximum of 0.50 percent by mass to maintain chemical stability and prevent rusting during storage.
Chemical assays must utilize concentrated hydrochloric acid conforming to IS 265, along with barium chloride, bromine solution, aluminium metal, and ammonium hydroxide.
Quantitatively determines phosphorus (percent by mass) using a volumetric back-titration of a digested sample with standard hydrochloric acid and a parallel control run.
To prevent ambient moisture absorption and premature oxidation, samples must not be drawn or prepared in an exposed place.
The sampling trier or instrument must be completely clean and dry before drawing material to avoid cross-contamination.
Volatile matter and elemental iron content tests must be carried out on each of the individual samples drawn from the consignment.
The remaining chemical characteristics, carbon impurities, and activity must be evaluated on the composite sample only.
All observed or calculated test and analytical values must be mathematically rounded off in accordance with IS 2:1960 to match the significant places of the specified limits.

plain_language_summary.summary: IS 1612 : 1976 (First Revision) is the primary national Indian Standard specification establishing technical requirements, chemical compositions, and sampling rules for reduction-grade iron powder. Developed under Sectional Committee CDC 3 and reaffirmed in 2024, this standard regulates iron powder used as a chemical reducing agent in the manufacture of dyes (like H-acid), pharmaceuticals, and intermediates. Key updates in this first revision incorporate a mandatory chemical activity test to verify actual reduction efficiency and lower the maximum carbon impurity limit from 2.5% to 2.0% by mass to prevent filtration clogs during product isolation, ensuring high operational reliability across chemical synthesis plants.
